configuration.database: PostgreSQL 16 local Docker, disposable database and restricted runtime role
configuration.backup_tools: Real pg_dump exported snapshot and pg_restore in the local PostgreSQL container
configuration.scenario: native_clients_v3 with actual HTTPS clients, pinned WASM and Docker runner

includes: Text/code conflict fragments and partial resolutions

timing.snapshot_to_cas_resolution: Manifest Unix timestamps with second precision

recovery_point.definition: Exported PostgreSQL snapshot identified by database_watermark_unix; CAS closure is retained at least through that snapshot
recovery_point.potential_loss_window: Age of the latest successfully verified backup's database snapshot at the incident time; writes committed after that snapshot may be absent

recovery_time.measured_phase: restore_backup including archive verification, CAS installation, pg_restore and native schema/identity verification

assertions: Restored Views and generations exactly match the quiescent source
All six immutable Release events retained with their CAS Evidence
Canonical closure verified; missing object, corrupt object and incomplete manifest refuse restoration
limitations: One local synthetic dataset; not a customer pilot or production-scale benchmark
No post-snapshot write-loss experiment or production scheduling SLA claimed
S3, offsite recovery and full service recovery time remain unqualified
